test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about the National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF), launched in 2024, is/are correct?

1. The total approved outlay of NMNF till 2025-26 is ₹1,000 crore.

2. The mission supports the establishment of Bio-input Resource Centres for providing Natural Farming inputs
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)** was launched to promote **sustainable and eco-friendly farming practices** in India.
 
• The mission emphasizes the adoption of **Natural Farming** methods, which involve the use of **bio-based inputs** instead of synthetic chemicals.
 
• One of the key components of the NMNF is the **establishment of Bio-input Resource Centres** to provide farmers with inputs for Natural Farming. These inputs include bio-fertilisers, bio-pesticides, and other organic resources</stron
